risk_notes: The first independent review found four Important specification gaps: movement from an initially conflicting AABB, new conflict-pair substitution, missing internal-copy placement rules and stale-index fallback safety.

The specification now defines a separate monotonic recovery branch, forbids new conflict-pair identities, routes internal copy through deterministic collision-safe placement and restores only latest authoritative geometry after stale-index cancellation.
The scoped re-review marked all four areas resolved, found no new Critical or Important contradiction and returned APPROVED.
This task changes design and workflow artifacts only; runtime behavior has not been implemented or tested.
Implementation planning remains blocked on explicit user approval of the written specification.
